prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Game asset sheet: modular MIDDLE FOREGROUND terrain-like scenery for Drowned-Bell-Sanctum.
Reference image supplies the approved biome's playable terrain materials and illustrated style. Required material: Wet teal/slate rock, sparse plump rounded moss clusters and broad fern accents.
Draw a square TRANSPARENT asset sheet in a regular 4-column by 4-row arrangement, EXACTLY ONE SEPARATE PIECE PER CELL, all sixteen pieces visible with clear transparent gutters. No drawn cell borders or labels.
Rows 1–3, columns 1–3 are a matching NINE-SLICE terrain mass kit: row1 top-left outer corner / top edge / top-right outer corner; row2 left wall / pure opaque black solid fill square / right wall; row3 bottom-left outer corner / underside edge / bottom-right outer corner. The solid black bodies are designed to connect; exposed rims show the biome material and fade inward into black. Edges should be chunky, rounded or irregularly sloping with substantial volume, not a thin outline.
Remaining seven cells: row1 column4 a tall CURVED COLUMN segment; row2 column4 a large irregular hanging OVERHANG; row3 column4 a sloping rounded foreground BOULDER/MOUND; row4 column1 an INNER CONCAVE CORNER; row4 column2 an opposite INNER CONCAVE CORNER; row4 column3 a LEFT ARCH HALF; row4 column4 a RIGHT ARCH HALF.
This is a modular tile kit assembled from real shaded volumes, NOT a horizontal foreground strip, not a flat silhouette border and not a scene. Natural material contours, asymmetric rounded masses, arches and concave recesses create depth. Each part uses fine dark contours, broad simple softly faceted painted shading, same hand-drawn underground game style as reference. Lit exposed edges, PURE BLACK opaque cutaway interiors, genuine transparent exterior and arch openings.
This layer sits immediately in front of playable terrain and behind the nearest dark strips. Slightly dimmer and lower-contrast than playable terrain, but enough coloured material detail to remain visibly distinct from the near-black front layer. Non-collidable scenery, avoid obvious flat standalone landing ledges among decorative extras. No background, no floor panorama, no characters, no text, grid lines, watermarks or baked checkerboards. Square 4x4 sheet.
method: Built-in image generation with approved biome concept as style/material reference.
